cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Use the Right Vocabulary
cards.instruction: Perform belonging by using official language confidently, adjusting each term whenever someone reveals what it actually means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. As your newest club member, I'd like to second the minutes. They took ages.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You second a motion. I'm proposing we approve the minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then I second your motion. Unanimously.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Unanimous means everyone agrees. Ruth hasn't voted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Seconded, with unanimity pending Ruth. Shall I put that in our minutes?

mechanism: A uses its former speaking pupil corrections to keep performing club procedural fluency, grading B clarity while immediately adopting the corrected terms.
confusable: Not secretly testing B with known answers: A misapplies each new term before the next correction and then confidently recruits B into club procedure.
comparison: Accounts terminology through old filing relationship versus club motions through old public-speaking relationship.
